scenes.line1: Why does FlatList feel so fast?
scenes.say: Ever wonder why FlatList is so quick with huge lists, but sometimes gets laggy? Let's break down how it works and what can trip you up.

scenes.label: FlatList
scenes.sub: Only renders visible items and recycles views.
scenes.say: FlatList keeps things smooth by only rendering what's on screen and recycling views as you scroll.

rows.b: Gives each item a stable key
Skips re-render if props don't change

scenes.say: To keep your list fast, use a key extractor for stable keys, pass extra data only when needed, and wrap item components with React memo.

scenes.code:
<FlatList
  data={data}
  renderItem={({item}) =>
    <ItemComponent item={item} />}
  keyExtractor={item => item.id}
  extraData={selectedId}
/>
scenes.say: Here's a typical FlatList setup. Notice the key extractor and extra data props—these help control re-renders.

scenes.question: What happens if you skip React.memo?
scenes.right: Items may re-render too often, slowing the list
scenes.say: If you forget React memo, your item components might re-render way more than needed, making the list feel sluggish.
